requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-5291-5929--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
5147-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.
5147-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

2018-3216-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

394-586-864-2034-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-2034-3125.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1257-5621-7857.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2348-3512-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Mana Flare triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2348-3512-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

225-751-3314-5621.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-751-3314-5621.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1274-2741-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2741-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2034-3125.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
147-2034-3125.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Dualcaster Mage and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

2436-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Marwyn.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G} and untapping it.
Repeat.

1978-4002-7290.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-7290.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Does Machines.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

112-3528-6496.manaNeeded: {15}{C}{C}{C}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-3528-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-3528-6496.description:
Cast Rise of the Eldrazi by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Rise of the Eldrazi and exiling the original Rise of the Eldrazi with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Rise of the Eldrazi and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Rise of the Eldrazi's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Rise of the Eldrazi and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Rise of the Eldrazi's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-3528-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Rise of the Eldrazi is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Rise of the Eldrazi is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

985-2478-4195-4574.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3678-4201-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-4201-6879.description:
Play Cabaretti Courtyard.
When Cabaretti Courtyard enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Cabaretti Courtyard.
Resolve the Cabaretti Courtyard trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it, search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
Haru triggers, returning Cabaretti Courtyard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5972-6054-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
5972-6054-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1491-4289-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Activate Kilo by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

856-997-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2060-3574-3921-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3574-3921-4222.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3574-3921-4222.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

4050-4053-5270-5791--52.notablePrerequisites:
Osteomancer Adept does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Food.
You have enough mana to cast the creature card in your graveyard.
4050-4053-5270-5791--52.description:
Activate Osteomancer Adept by tapping it, allowing you to cast creature spells from your graveyard this turn by foraging in addition to the spell's other costs.
Cast the creature card that can be cast using one colored mana from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and sacrificing a Food.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating a Food token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Blazing Sunsteel.

2723-4273.notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel and Copy Artifact attached to an indestructible creature you control.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
2723-4273.description:
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
Blazing Sunsteel and Copy Artifact trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to any target.
Resolve the Copy Artifact trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 2.

844-2232-4050-5649.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
When Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Bladewing's Thrall trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall, adding {R}.
Repeat.

323-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
323-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

724-1636-4574-4771.notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
724-1636-4574-4771.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing itself, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Hidetsugu's second ability by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, exiling Myr Scrapling from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile this turn, and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Myr Scrapling from exile by paying {1}.
Myr Scrapling enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2431-4499-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2431-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Deepglow Skate.
Deepglow Skate enters the battlefield, doubling the number of counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1339-2835-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1765-2733-3263-4659.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {1}, targeting any creature you control.
Shimmering Wings enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {2}.
Activate Shimmering Wings' second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1119-1651-1737-3698.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Tree of Tales.
The Tree of Tales token enters, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Tree of Tales token and Grinding Station, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

57-538-1402-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-538-1402-2178.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each of your opponent.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

34-813-1777.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying {2}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Footsteps of the Goryo from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

539-2800-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-2800-4657.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Mirari's Wake triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

1308-2143.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2856-3554-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Mystical Tutor and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Mystical Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.
